description: Centre Régional Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes de l'Information Géographique: positioning datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Centre Régional Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes de l'Information Géographique. Coverage: Centre Régional Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes de l'Information Géographique. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about positioning; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: AURI - Base GNSS du site des Carmes à Aurillac (15); CVRA - Base GNSS du site Brel à Valence (26); CT2M - Base GNSS du site Eugène Beaune à Saint-Étienne (42); CRLV - Base GNSS de la Maison de la Jeunesse et de l'Emploi de Riom (6. Formats seen: 0-HTTP--LINK, OGC:WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
